note: triaged upstream findings (docs/runbooks/security-patch.md). umami_repository_advisories: umami repository advisories triaged against the pinned umami; scripts/supply-chain/advisories.py reports every published advisory not listed. upstream_image_findings: fixable critical and high trivy findings of an upstream image at an exact tag, as "<id> <package>"; scripts/supply-chain/report-findings.py files only the findings of an image that are not listed for its pinned tag, so a new tag is triaged again. npm_advisories: pnpm audit advisories below the high severity the hourly workflow files, triaged against the lockfile and the console bundle. add an entry only after triage, with the decision; the evidence is in docs/security/supply-chain.md section 8.1.

umami_repository_advisories.decision: published 2023-07-27, before the 3.x line; the pinned 3.5.0 is a later release. listed so the check reports only new advisories.
published 2026-06-30, before 3.5.0 (2026-11-12) was pinned. listed so the check reports only new advisories.

sql injection in the reports api (POST /api/reports/*) through filters[*].paramName, unauthenticated with a share token from GET /api/share/<slug>; advisory range <= 3.4.0, no patched version stated. the pinned 3.5.0 carries the fix (upstream commit 4fa9769519, src/lib/params.ts derives the placeholder name from the validated key). not reachable from the internet either: no public host serves umami, and make test-caddy-closed (deploy/caddy/umami_closed_test.go) fails when an internet-facing caddy config refers to it. checked on the private network against the pinned image: the advisory's payloads run as plain filters (200, no division by zero, no sleep), while umami 3.4.0 answers the same payloads with a database error and a 4 second delay. no upgrade or deny rule needed.

upstream_image_findings.decision: undici http client findings only. umami makes no outbound request here (PRIVATE_MODE, DISABLE_TELEMETRY, DISABLE_UPDATES; TestWebPath checks no egress), and inbound requests are served by next.js, not undici. no newer umami release exists.
upstream_image_findings.revisit: the next umami release, through make umami-upgrade

upstream_image_findings.decision: every finding is in a bundled data source plugin binary under data/plugins-bundled. the only provisioned data source is prometheus, grafana listens on 127.0.0.1 only, sign-up and anonymous access are off. 13.3.1, the newest release, carries the same findings.
upstream_image_findings.revisit: 13.2.7, or a 13.x release without these findings

upstream_image_findings.decision: alpine musl and zlib packages; the exporter is a statically linked go binary that loads neither, and the entrypoint shell takes no outside input. newest release.
govulncheck -mode=binary: the x/net/html symbols are not in the binary. 0.35.0 carries the same finding.

govulncheck -mode=binary: x/net/html, x/crypto, x/text, CVE-2026-46600 and CVE-2026-78667 are not in the binary; the rest are denial of service in the http server, tls and parsers or an x509 client issue. the exporter listens on the private address only, without tls, and only prometheus scrapes it. newest release.
govulncheck -mode=binary: the x/net/html symbols are not in the binary. 3.16.0 carries the same finding.

govulncheck -mode=binary: x/net/html, x/crypto, x/text, CVE-2026-39821, -39822, -56859 and -78667 are not in the binary. the exporter is on the private address of the postgresql hosts only, scraped by prometheus, and connects only to postgresql as a pg_monitor role. newest release.

x/net html parser denial of service; the symbol is in the binary but no etcd api takes html. etcd ports are on the private address only, firewalled to the private network, and patroni is the only client. 3.7.3, the newest release, carries the same finding, so the minor jump would not fix it.
upstream_image_findings.revisit: 3.6.17, or a release built with golang.org/x/net 0.62.0

upstream_image_findings.decision: govulncheck -mode=binary: the x/image and x/net/html symbols are not in the binary. go-jose is used only by the oidc login, which gatus.yml does not configure. the gatus port is not published; only the probe caddy reaches it over http/1.1, so no outside client sends it http/2 frames. newest release.

npm_advisories.decision: no patched version exists (vulnerable <= 6.6.1). the only path is @creit.tech/stellar-wallets-kit > @hot-wallet/sdk > @near-wallet-selector/core > near-api-js > @near-js/crypto > secp256k1 > elliptic, installed for the console, the console e2e suite, the tracker's wallets kit adapter tests and the wallets kit example. the console imports only the kit's module api and its own list of wallet modules, never the hot or near connectors; apps/console/scripts/bundle-packages.mjs lists neither elliptic, secp256k1 nor any near package in the bundle. no shipped artifact runs the code.
npm_advisories.revisit: a wallets kit release without the near connector, or an elliptic release with a fix
